readerCopy.body: A threat loses power once the consequence behind it is no longer enough to force compliance. When Pluto opposes Lilith, concentrated power meets a refusal that is no longer willing to pay the same price for access, approval, money, status, or peace. Questions of control become harder to ignore once the consequence is named plainly. What has been tolerated can become much harder to keep tolerating after the threat stops feeling absolute. The useful shift is the one that reduces the old source of control instead of turning resistance into another contest over who controls the terms.
